name: mike-docs
description: FastNEAR docs backend and generation workspace

scripts.preview: npm run sync:apis && ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS=true node scripts/redocly-root-guard.js preview
scripts.preview:fresh-examples: npm run sync:apis && node scripts/refresh-examples.js && ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS=true node scripts/redocly-root-guard.js preview
scripts.build: npm run check:external-openapi && npm run sync:apis && node scripts/redocly-root-guard.js build && node scripts/run-realm-build.js
scripts.build:fresh-examples: npm run check:external-openapi && npm run sync:apis && node scripts/redocly-root-guard.js build && node scripts/run-realm-build.js --refresh-examples
scripts.lint: npm run check:external-openapi && npm run sync:apis && node scripts/redocly-root-guard.js lint
scripts.verify:workspace: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run audit:page-model-routes && npm run audit:structured-graph && npm run audit:rpc-example-placeholders && npm run audit:rpc-examples:all && npm run audit:fastnear-defaults && npm run audit:transfers-defaults && npm run audit:kv-fastdata-defaults && npm run audit:neardata-defaults && npm run audit:transactions-defaults

author: FastNEAR
